scope-boundary: CHANGES: (1) the live lane gets a third model identity, DeepSeek V4 Flash through Pi's deepseek provider (pi-ai id deepseek-flash) with the owner's DeepSeek key from the macOS Keychain, and a governed coding run with three distinct identities (W3 stages A-E: admission, independent coding with Fleiss kappa and Krippendorff alpha, reconciliation and report gate, adversarial/debate, fail-closed probes) runs on Harbor evidence units; (2) M4 judge validation v2 is pre-registered before its run: construction-labelled items whose truth is known by construction on the synthetic corpus (binary answer-bearing relevance; planted supported, other-theme and number-altered claims), a judge is trusted when Cohen's kappa is at least 0.60 on the tasks it performs for the score, each generator is judged by the two other models, judge agreement is reported, and the v1 rule's outcome is reported beside it; (3) embeddings become role-aware (query versus document prompts per model family, taken from each model card) and the prompt scheme becomes part of the vector-space identity (cache namespace and fingerprint), multilingual candidates (EmbeddingGemma-300m, Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, BGE-M3) are measured against nomic-embed-text on qrels extended with at least 30 Spanish questions using paired randomization tests with Holm correction, and the default embedder changes to the winner only if it is significantly better overall and on Spanish without a significant English regression; existing installs move through a new embedding-profile version and a re-index, never by mixing vector spaces; installers, docs and the Health tab name the model; (4) the seven complexity warnings from gate after are fixed (functions under the threshold or back at their baseline, the oversized test module split). MUST STAY UNCHANGED: coding-run reliability rules (>=3 distinct identities, served_model proof, exact-substring quotes, duplicate ratings fail closed, kappa >= 0.60), report gates, auth and authorization, project isolation, engine-resolution order, content-free telemetry, the credential-free QA stub lane, no private host names or secrets in committed files, and no silent mixing of vector spaces. Verification: a pytest per behaviour change that fails on origin/main; Playwright scenarios for any UI change across the matrix; extended M1 plus the embedder comparison; live-lane runs for the coding run and M4; security benchmark; change and feature obligation checkers; CF gate before/after with no new failures or warnings.
